newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo to launch human growth hormone in US.
newsitem.headline: Novo to launch human growth hormone in US.

text.p: Danish pharmaceutical and biotechnology group Novo Nordisk said on Friday it planned to launch its new Norditropin human growth hormone in the United States following the suspension of a temporary U.S. court injunction.

It said the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit had reversed a former injunction by a lower court in an ongoing litigation patent row with rival Genentech, allowing it now to go ahead and market the product in America.

"During the entire course of this complex case, we have all the time maintained that Novo Nordisk should not be kept out of the U.S. market," Novo health care division director Lars Rebien Soerensen said in a statement.

"The appeal court ruling removes a major factor hindering us from access to the market in the United States. Now that the injunction has been suspended, we intend to go ahead and market our human growth hormone in the United States," he said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
